correctness.rationale: At p^a the allowed valuations min(v_p(x),a) are precisely even ones, including zero only if a even. For r<=p, p-r residue classes avoid p, while each of r classes containing a single multiple of p admits B_p(a-2) eligible lifts for a>=2; for p<r<=2p exactly 2p-r classes contain one multiple; r>=2p has two multiples separated by p so at least one forbidden valuation one. At a=1 only p-r classes contribute. CRT multiplies the independent local counts without statistical assumptions. Positivity at local r=p-1 or 2p-1 proves exact global longest run; second finite difference W(r)-2W(r+1)+W(r+2) counts maximal cyclic runs because A_n is a proper subset n>=2.
